title: Stableflow
tagline: Unified liquidity across all chains—bridged invisibly, accessed instantly.
description:
We built Stable Flow to solve a major pain point: businesses keeping funds scattered across multiple blockchains. With our platform, you maintain one main liquidity pool while customers pay from any chain they want.
Here's how we make it work. Your business keeps all funds on your preferred origin chain—say Ethereum. When a customer on Polygon wants to pay, our AI agent detects the request instantly. We use LayerZero's cross-chain messaging to bridge the exact amount needed from your Ethereum pool to Polygon in real-time. The customer clicks pay, the transaction completes, and nobody realizes cross-chain bridging just happened.
We integrate Coinbase Developer Smart Wallet so customers use one unified account across all chains. They don't juggle multiple wallets or select networks—they just transact normally. On your end, you see incoming payments without worrying about which blockchain they originated from.
LayerZero handles the secure verification between chains while we orchestrate the liquidity movement automatically. Our agent continuously monitors transaction requests across all supported networks and dynamically routes funds where they're needed. You're not manually bridging assets or splitting your treasury—we handle that complexity invisibly.
